title: Neuralwatt: MiMo-V2.6-Pro
brief: Neuralwatt Cloud's model page for Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1M context, sparse MoE) — $0.87/$1.74 per million in/out tokens, a 35%-off Flex tier, live latency/throughput stats, per-request energy figures, and OpenAI-compatible API examples. details: Neuralwatt Cloud's model page for Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro (sparse MoE, 1M-token context, native vision and tool calling), served at $0.87/$1.74 per million input/output tokens with a 35%-off Flex tier for non-urgent work.
